articles.title: Circle debuts Arc blockchain which Jeremy Allaire calls ‘more consequential’ than USDC
articles.snippet: The USDC issuer's chain is built for payments, tokenized assets and institutional finance as banks and payment giants pile into the stablecoin market.

articles.title: Two Robinhood engineers charged with insider trading using Hyperliquid perpetuals
articles.snippet: U.S. prosecutors allege two engineers used confidential Robinhood token listing data to front-run announcements using Hyperliquid perpetual futures.

articles.title: Bernstein expects ‘aggressive’ rulemaking from SEC, CFTC, following CLARITY Act failure
articles.snippet: Bernstein said the federal agencies will publish new regulations to compensate for the time lost negotiating the CLARITY Act, after its cloture vote failed on Tuesday.

articles.title: US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: The failed procedural vote leaves the CLARITY Act facing an uncertain future after months of negotiations over crypto oversight and ethics provisions.

articles.title: Zuckerberg Pushes Back on Coordinated AI Slowdown, Says Labs Can Act Alone
articles.snippet: Meta’s CEO says competition and potential liability give AI developers reasons to prioritize safety, citing the company’s decision to delay Muse.
